title: Fling Plugin
description: Plugin for launching/flinging players on Spigot/Paper servers
body:
Hier ist eine professionelle Modrinth-Beschreibung für dein Plugin! 🎮

Fling Plugin
⚡ Fun and Customizable Plugin for Spigot/Paper Servers ⚡
Description
Fling Plugin is a lightweight and fun plugin that allows administrators to fling players in random directions! Perfect for pranks, games, minigames, or just having fun on your server.
Simply use the command /fling <player> and watch your players get launched into the air in unpredictable directions!
Features
✨ Easy to Use - Simple /fling <player> command
✨ Fully Customizable - Configure all messages and power in config.yml
✨ Random Directions - Players get flung in random directions every time
✨ Configurable Power - Adjust the fling strength to your liking
✨ Permission System - Admin-only by default, but easily configurable
✨ No Notification - Target players won't know who flung them
✨ Lightweight - Minimal performance impact
Commands

/fling <player> - Flings a player in a random direction

Requires: fling.use permission (Default: OP)



Configuration
Edit config.yml to customize:

fling-power - Control how far players get flung (1.0 - 5.0)
messages - Customize all plugin messages with colors and formatting

Installation

Download the plugin JAR file
Place it in your server's plugins/ folder
Restart your server or use /reload
Configure the config.yml to your liking
